messages:
maya (Marketing): Heads-up team — final announce tomorrow. Need: published changelog URL, docs quickstart link, confirmed canary window, and webinar CTA copy. Slide review 15:30 PT.
ben (Eng): Canary plan: 11:30-13:30 PT tomorrow. We'll run perf + stability profile; fallback to the 8-bit quantized build if latency regresses. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/789
carla (Docs): Publishing the quickstart and migration notes now. Drafts will be at https://docs.redwood.com/release/4965432100-draft by 14:45 PT. Will add a short "how to upgrade" section.
diego (PM): Marketing one-liner we can push in the email/webinar banner? Need to be crisp for the header and alt headline for social.
maya (Marketing): Draft header: "Ship faster, spend less — adaptive batching + quantization in Redwood Optimize". Alternate short: "Faster inference, smaller bills". Open to tweaks from Eng on claims.
ben (Eng): If we call out savings, let's phrase as "internal benchmark shows median 22% unit-cost reduction on long sequences" and mark as internal metrics until QA signs off.
eve (Release): Runbook uploaded: /runbooks/release-4965432100.md. I'll trigger deploy-bot 20m before canary. Rollback hook: `./run revert --tag 4965432100`.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled at 11:10 PT. Canary 11:30-13:30 PT. Will post status in #release-war-room.
olivia (Webinar Ops): Webinar slot at 9:00 AM PT morning demo. Registration form will include hidden field `release_q2_496543` and webhook to create MQL. I'll test webhook at 14:50 PT and report status.
maya (Marketing): For lead routing: tag leads as "release_q2_496543" -> route to AE Team C. Can someone confirm SFDC mapping works?
diego (PM): Confirmed. Hubspot -> SFDC mapping includes source tags. Olivia, make sure the hidden field is present on the registration page.
carla (Docs): Quick note — the docs link will include a short benchmark appendix pointing to an internal notebook; I'll flag it as "internal benchmarks" and not quote numbers in marketing copy until Ben gives QA thumbs-up.
ben (Eng): QA target for the bench numbers is 17:00 PT today. If we hit a regression in canary, temporary mitigation is `--no-kv-cache` and toggling batching window to 32 tokens. Ops command: `ctl feature flip batching_window=32 --release 4965432100`.
maya (Marketing): Please drop the final changelog URL and the exact doc quickstart URL here when published so I can paste into the email and social copy. Planning announcement send at 17:00 PT.
eve (Release): Will confirm final status by 16:45 PT. If all green, proceed.
olivia (Webinar Ops): Webhook test at 14:50 PT passed. Slides review at 15:30 PT — tagging Eng + Docs to join.
maya (Marketing): Awesome — slide + copy review 15:30, final signoff 16:45, announce 17:00. Thanks everyone :rocket:
